name: Update Lease
description: Update a lease. Note: IsMtm and EndOn are mutually exclusive and cannot be set in the same request.

pathParams.name: LeaseId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the lease to update

requestBody.description: Update lease object. At least one attribute must be provided. Note: IsMtm and EndOn are mutually exclusive and cannot be set in the same request.

attributes.name: EndOn
attributes.description: The end date of the lease. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD. Cannot be set if IsMtm is true.

attributes.name: IsMtm
attributes.description: Indicates if the lease is month-to-month. Cannot be set to true if EndOn is provided.

attributes.name: RenewedOn
attributes.description: The date the lease was renewed. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated lease
